text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- EU leaders consider it important that Russia does not link signing border agreements to other issues such as the rights of Russian-speakers abroad, EU Foreign Affairs Commissioner Hans Van Den Broek said in Moscow.
- The ruling minority coalition of the Coalition Party and a bloc of smaller rural parties invited leading opposition parties the Reform Party and the Centre Party to form a wide-based coalition.
- A bomb went off under the car of a former customs official who was slightly injured. An earlier attempt to kill the official was made last year when he was shot and wounded.
- Finnish Interior Minister Jan-Erik Enestam discussed the techincal problems of a visa-free regime during a visit to Tallinn.
- The port of Parnu closed due to heavy ice and the lack of ice-breakers.
- Eesti Gaas is planning to raise gas prices from May and to differentiate between industrial and individual users.
